principle: The smallest schema that does not collapse meaningful equipment relationships.

entityType.purpose: States what a technical configuration actually is so complete firearms, receivers, uppers, components, optics, mounts, ammunition, and bundles never collapse into one model identity.

offeringType.purpose: Separates the commercial package from the technical identity or identities it contains.

relationships: organizationRelationship records owns, markets, or licenses with domain, market, interval, and evidence scope
authority associates exact configuration for explicit scope and interval
targetZeroRelationship binds exact equipment, sight, ammunition, governed zero distance, target, and confirmation distance/protocol
successor supplements_or_replaces predecessor for explicit scope and interval
alias resolves_to one canonical entity or remains ambiguous

relationshipRecords.rule: Organization identity is stable. Ownership, marketing, and licensing are time-scoped evidence-bearing relationships, never a timeless manufacturer scalar.

factAttachment.rule: Every authority-sensitive value and every asserted relationship carries its own factEnvelope. A record-level provenance snapshot alone is insufficient.

distanceSemantics.zeroDistance: The governed distance at which the equipment/sight/ammunition/target zero relationship is established.
distanceSemantics.confirmationDistance: The governed distance at which that zero relationship is confirmed, when authority defines one.
distanceSemantics.sessionDistance: Transient distance for today's execution. It belongs to Session Authority/execution evidence and must not be stored as targetZeroRelationship.zeroDistance by implication.

identityRules: Action, form factor, platform, model, configuration, and commercial offering are distinct.
Complete firearm, receiver, upper, component, and bundle identities remain distinct through entityType and offeringType.
Organization ownership, marketing, and licensing are scoped relationships rather than timeless manufacturer facts.
Optics-ready does not establish optic compatibility.
Adjustment behavior belongs to the exact sight/configuration relationship.
A package, finish, or compliance SKU does not automatically create a new technical model.
Military platform identity, manufacturer implementation, commercial product, and issued configuration do not merge.
Unlike catalog-depth counts must not be summed into an exact-model denominator.
A conflicting fact never overrides locked runtime authority without governed reconciliation.

shooterProjection.reuse: Offer the active saved equipment profile wherever the selected experience can truthfully consume it.
shooterProjection.unknownEscape: Other / I don't see mine preserves a shooter declaration without creating catalog authority.
